question: The Temple at Khajuraho were built during which dynasty?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chandella dynasty**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Temple at Khajuraho** were built during the **Chandella dynasty.**
 
• **The Chandellas **were a **medieval Indian dynasty **that ruled over the region of **Bundelkhand in central India** from the** 9th to the 13th centuries.**
 
• **The temples at Khajuraho**, known for their **intricate carvings and architectural beauty,** were constructed during the** peak of the Chandella dynasty's reign, between the 10th and 12th centuries.​**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Maurya dynasty**:

 
 
• **The Maurya dynasty **was an **ancient Indian dynasty that ruled from the 4th to the 2nd century BCE.**
 
• It was founded by** Chandragupta Maurya** and reached its **zenith under the reign of Ashoka the Great.**
 
• **The Maurya dynasty** is known for its political and military achievements, as well as Ashoka's conversion to Buddhism and promotion of its principles.
 
 
 
• **Nanda dynasty: **
 
 
• **The Nanda dynasty** was an **ancient Indian dynasty **that existed during the **4th century BCE.**
 
• It was founded by **Mahapadma Nanda** and was one of the **earliest historical dynasties in India.**
 
• **The Nanda dynasty **ruled over the **Magadha region **and expanded their empire through military conquests. 
 
 
 
• **Vijayanagara dynasty: **
 
 
• **The Vijayanagara Empire** was a prominent **South Indian empire** that thrived from the **14th to the 17th centuries CE.**
 
• It was founded by** Harihara I **and **Bukka Raya I **and reached its peak under the rule of **Krishnadevaraya.**
 
• **The empire **was known for its cultural and architectural achievements, including the construction of **numerous temples and monuments.**
